varna.description: Varna koota compares the spiritual/social compatibility. Max: 1 point.
varna.scoring: 1 if groom's varna is equal or higher than bride's, 0 otherwise
varna.text: Varna assesses fundamental nature compatibility. Brahmin natures are spiritual, Kshatriya are warriors/leaders, Vaishya are merchants, Shudra are service-oriented. This koota carries 1 point.

vashya.description: Vashya assesses mutual attraction and influence. Max: 2 points.
vashya.text: Vashya koota carries 2 points and assesses control and mutual attraction between the partners based on Moon signs.

tara.description: Tara relates to health and longevity based on nakshatras. Max: 3 points.
tara.text: Tara koota carries 3 points and is calculated by the distance between the birth nakshatras of the partners.

yoni.description: Yoni checks physical and sexual compatibility. Max: 4 points.
yoni.text: Yoni koota carries 4 points and assigns an animal to each nakshatra to measure sexual and biological compatibility.

graha_maitri.description: Graha Maitri measures mental compatibility and friendship. Max: 5 points.
graha_maitri.text: Graha Maitri evaluates planetary friendship between the Moon sign lords of both partners, carrying 5 points.

gana.description: Gana looks at temperamental compatibility. Max: 6 points.
gana.text: Gana koota carries 6 points. Nakshatras are divided into Deva, Manushya, and Rakshasa ganas, determining temperament.

bhakoot.description: Bhakoot or Rashi koota measures emotional and family welfare. Max: 7 points.
bhakoot.text: Bhakoot koota evaluates the relationship between the moon signs, checking for inauspicious intervals like 6/8, carrying 7 points.

nadi.description: Nadi evaluates genetic/physiological compatibility. Max: 8 points.
nadi.text: Nadi koota is the most crucial, carrying 8 points. Same-nadi combinations are considered highly problematic for health and progeny.
